title: Service Advisor - L. Save as canned line (carrying attached inspection template)
preconds: Logged in as Service Advisor. WO = View/Create&Edit (no WO Delete) but WOL = V/E/D -> full inspection rights follow the LINE (SV-8095). A work order line has an attached (published) inspection template.
steps:
1. Log in.
  2. Open a work order line that has an attached inspection template.
  3. From the line's three-dot menu, choose "Save as canned line".
expected: Step 3: Allowed. "Save as canned line" - including carrying the line's attached inspection template - requires WOL Create and Edit, NOT Settings > Service (the template is only referenced, already published). Service Advisor has WOL Create and Edit. (SV-8095 AC7; fixes SV-7872.)
